# GitHub Repository Automation Specification

<!-- Last audited at: 2026-07-10 -->

## EARS Requirements

**DECL-GITHUB-01** When repository dependency automation runs, the system shall use the versioned update policy and pull-request metadata.

**DECL-GITHUB-02** If automation configuration is invalid, the system shall fail its configuration check before changing repository state.
